## Abstract

The Business Architecture domain encompasses decisions related to business capability modeling, value stream optimization, business process design, organizational alignment, and strategic business initiatives. This domain ensures that technology investments align with business objectives and deliver measurable value.

Business architecture decisions drive enterprise strategy execution, operational efficiency, and organizational transformation initiatives across the enterprise.
